opportunities.title: Blesta LogicBoxes Hosting Module Development
opportunities.description: # Project Requirement: LogicBoxes (ResellerClub) Shared Hosting Module for Blesta We are looking to develop a custom **Blesta provisioning module** to integrate LogicBoxes (ResellerClub) via API for ordering and managing **Linux Shared Hosting services**, supporting both **cPanel and Plesk** control panels. The module should support single and multiple hosting product purchases within one order and provide complete hosting lifecycle automation, including account provisioning, suspension, reactivation, upgrades, renewals, and termination. ## 1. Core Module Features & Requirements ### A. API Configuration - Configure LogicBoxes API credentials (Reseller ID and API Key). - API endpoint configuration. - Sandbox and Live environment support, if available. - Test Connection button to validate API credentials. - Display API connection status and meaningful error messages. ### B. Hosting Package Mapping - Retrieve available shared hosting plans through the LogicBoxes API. - Map LogicBoxes hosting plans to Blesta packages. - Support multiple shared hosting plans. - Support cPanel and Plesk hosting products. - Allow administrators to configure and manage package mappings. ### C. Automated Provisioning Upon successful order/payment and according to Blesta provisioning settings, the module should: - Automatically create shared hosting accounts through the API. - Support single and multiple hosting products within one order. - Create or identify the corresponding customer account. - Assign the selected hosting package. - Associate the customer's domain with the hosting account. - Save the hosting account and provider order IDs in Blesta. - Retrieve account credentials and hosting information when available. - Send a customized welcome email containing hosting access details. - Handle provisioning failures and API errors without creating duplicate accounts. ### D. Hosting Account Management (Admin Area) Administrators should be able to: - View complete hosting account information. - Create hosting accounts manually. - Suspend hosting accounts. - Unsuspend/reactivate hosting accounts. - Terminate hosting accounts. - Change hosting account passwords. - Upgrade or downgrade hosting packages. - Synchronize hosting account information with LogicBoxes. - View provisioning status and API responses. - Access the customer's hosting control panel. ### E. Admin Control Panel Access - Provide one-click login for administrators to access the customer's hosting control panel. - Support cPanel and Plesk. - Use secure authentication or supported single sign-on mechanisms. - Avoid exposing customer passwords or API credentials. ### F. Client Area Integration Display hosting service information in the Blesta client area, including: - Domain name. - Hosting package name. - Hosting account username. - Hosting server information. - Nameservers. - Hosting account status. - Account creation date. - Expiry/renewal date, where available. - Available hosting resource information, where supported by the API. ### G. Client Control Panel Login - Provide a one-click login button to access the hosting control panel. - Support cPanel and Plesk. - Use secure authentication or single sign-on where available. - Allow customers to access their respective hosting accounts without entering credentials again, where supported. ### H. Password Management - Allow customers to change or reset their hosting account password from the Blesta client area. - Validate password requirements. - Update the password through the LogicBoxes API. - Display appropriate success or error notifications. ### I. Hosting Package Upgrade/Downgrade - Display available upgrade and downgrade packages. - Allow customers to request package changes. - Calculate applicable upgrade/downgrade charges through Blesta. - Process package changes through the provider API where supported. - Synchronize updated package information with Blesta. ### J. Hosting Lifecycle Automation The module should integrate with Blesta's service lifecycle: - Automatic provisioning after successful payment. - Automatic suspension based on Blesta suspension settings. - Automatic unsuspension after payment. - Hosting renewal synchronization. - Scheduled or immediate termination according to cancellation settings. - Automatic synchronization of hosting service status. - Error handling and retry mechanisms for failed API operations. ## 2. Technical Requirements - PHP development using the official Blesta provisioning module architecture. - LogicBoxes/ResellerClub API integration. - Compatible with our installed Blesta version. - Support for multiple shared hosting products and services. - cPanel and Plesk support. - Secure API credential storage. - Proper API logging and error handling. - No modifications to Blesta core files. - Responsive admin and client-area interfaces. - Complete source code and installation documentation. ## 3. Important Development Clarifications Before development, please verify: - Which shared hosting operations are supported through the LogicBoxes API. - Whether both cPanel and Plesk hosting products can be provisioned and managed. - Whether package upgrades/downgrades are supported through the API. - Whether secure one-click control panel login is available. - Whether hosting account information and resource usage can be retrieved through the API. Please identify any API limitations before finalizing the development scope. ## 4. Please Provide Your Proposal 1. Your availability to start this project. 2. Estimated development timeline. 3. Total development cost or fixed-price quotation. 4. Your previous experience developing custom Blesta modules. 5. Your experience integrating LogicBoxes/ResellerClub APIs. 6. Any technical limitations or additional requirements you identify. We are looking for a complete, production-ready Blesta provisioning module with both admin and client-area functionality, not just a basic API integration. Budget: 80 Dollar

opportunities.title: Ethical Contact Data Scraper
opportunities.description: Hiring: Backend Data Extraction & Web Scraping Specialist I'm looking for an experienced Backend Data Extraction Engineer / Ethical Hacker with strong expertise in database integration, server-side data processing, and web scraping. Project Requirements The primary objective is to collect and organize available contact information from authorized data sources. Required Technical Expertise: - Backend database integration (MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB). - Server-side data extraction using authorized API endpoints. - Web scraping using Python, BeautifulSoup, Scrapy, or Selenium. - Structured data extraction and processing. - Phone number and email extraction from permitted datasets. - Duplicate detection, validation, and data cleaning. - CSV / Excel export automation. Expected Deliverables 1. A clean, well-documented Python or Node.js script. 2. Configurable extraction settings. 3. Structured CSV / Excel output. 4. Duplicate-free and validated records. 5. Error handling and extraction logs. 6. Step-by-step setup and execution documentation for Windows/Linux. Important Requirements - Experience with backend architecture and database structures. - Understanding of REST APIs and server-side data workflows. - Secure handling of credentials and personal information. - Work only with systems and datasets for which access is authorized. Looking for someone with strong practical experience, not just basic web scraping knowledge.

opportunities.title: Sistema AI Lead Traslochi
opportunities.description: Voglio creare un ecosistema di agenti AI che individui nuovi potenziali clienti online e alimenti il mio team commerciale di traslochi con contatti realmente interessati. Obiettivo • Generare lead qualificati in modo continuativo, puntando su Google, siti di annunci locali, Facebook e Instagram. Area di copertura • L’AI dovrà operare su tutta la mia regione, ottimizzando la spesa pubblicitaria e filtrando soltanto i contatti coerenti con le tratte servite. Cosa mi aspetto 1. Strategia di acquisizione: studio delle chiavi di ricerca, definizione dei pubblici social e configurazione tracciamento conversioni. 2. Implementazione agenti AI: – Chatbot o flusso conversazionale che intercetti l’utente, raccolga i dati essenziali (luogo di partenza/arrivo, metratura, data indicativa) e valuti il potenziale valore del trasloco. – Automazione follow-up via e-mail o WhatsApp per mantenere caldo il contatto fino al passaggio al reparto preventivi. 3. opportunities.title: Video Call API Automation
opportunities.description: I need an automation script that talks directly to a mainstream video-conferencing API and runs hands-free on my server. The core idea is to take routine meeting tasks—creating sessions, sending out links, auto-joining when required, even pushing reminders—and turn them into simple function calls that my backend can trigger on demand. The exact platform is still open; Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams or a comparable service are all on the table. I’m happy to decide together once you confirm which API best matches the feature set above and your experience. Whichever we choose, the script must run continuously (or on cron) on a Linux VPS and expose clear hooks—CLI commands, a lightweight REST endpoint, or another mechanism you prefer—so my existing web app can call it programmatically. Key expectations • Clean, well-commented code in Python, Node.js, or another widely supported language • Environment file for all tokens / secrets, no hard-coding • README with step-by-step deployment on Ubuntu 22.04, including crontab or systemd setup for unattended execution • Simple logging so I can trace each API call and response If you can include a small Postman or cURL collection to demonstrate the endpoints, even better. Once it’s live on my server and performs the agreed actions reliably, the job is done.

opportunities.title: AI-Driven Real Estate CMA Automation
opportunities.description: I want to build an end-to-end Comparative Market Analysis platform that automatically pulls fresh data from our MLS feed, zeroes-in on a specified ZIP code, and selects the most relevant comparables for each subject property. The first milestone is the engine that finds and ranks similar homes; it must weigh location, recent sale price and date, home size, bed/bath count, lot size, property type, condition, and local amenities to produce an accurate shortlist. Once the comp-selection logic is solid, I’ll connect an AI agent so the system can draft narrative summaries, pricing recommendations, and branded reports we can hand directly to clients. Think Python or Node back-end, MLS API integration, vector search or traditional scoring for similarity, and an OpenAI (or equivalent) layer for natural-language output—all wired into a web dashboard my team can use daily. Key deliverables • Zip-code based comp-selection module pulling live MLS data • Weighted scoring model reflecting the criteria above • AI-generated summary and pricing recommendation template • Simple dashboard with file export (PDF/Word) for finished CMA reports • Deployment script or CI pipeline so we can keep iterating each month Acceptance criteria 1. On a test ZIP code I provide, the system returns at least five high-quality comparables ranked by relevance. 2. Generated report passes a spot-check for factual accuracy against MLS records. 3. Turnaround from property address input to finished report is under two minutes. This is an ongoing role paid monthly, so clean, well-documented code and an architecture that can grow into additional ZIP codes and features matter just as much as the initial build. If you have solid experience with MLS integrations and AI text generation, let’s get started right away.

opportunities.title: 24/7 AI Crypto Co-Founder Agent
opportunities.description: Title: AI Crypto Co-Founder Agent (24/7) - WhatsApp, Gmail, Voice Calls I am a crypto founder in India building an EVM Layer-1 project (Shanzai). I need a 24/7 AI agent that acts like a co-founder: monitors the whole crypto market, researches for my project, messages me on WhatsApp/Gmail, calls me, and answers my questions. CORE FEATURES 1. Market monitoring (every 2-5 min, alert on thresholds): - Whole crypto market: BTC, ETH, major L1s/L2s, DeFi, memecoins. - Top gainers/losers, sudden pumps/dumps, volume spikes, new trending tokens (CoinGecko, DexScreener, DefiLlama or similar). - Memecoin watch with basic risk flags (low liquidity, new token, concentrated holders). - Important news, hacks, scams, India crypto regulation. 2. Hourly update to 2 phone numbers on WhatsApp (short, clear summary) + Gmail. 3. Two-way WhatsApp: I can message the agent any question about crypto or my project and get a reply (Claude API). Telegram bot as backup. 4. Voice call every 6 hours (Vapi or similar) to both numbers: 2-3 minute discussion of the project and market, Hindi + English, and I can talk back. Confirm India calling method, cost and limits. 5. Project discovery for Shanzai (twice daily deep research, with links): investors, grants, competitors, partnerships, exchanges/launchpads, growth ideas, new EVM L1 trends. 6. Honest advice: the agent must say what is wrong or risky and what is good. No hype, no profit promises, no price predictions as facts. Always include sources and uncertainty. 7. Explain crypto in simple words when I ask. RULES - Agent has NO access to wallets, keys, exchanges, trading or payments. Read-only plus messaging. - All accounts (Make/n8n, Claude API, Vapi, WhatsApp API, Telegram, hosting) in MY name. Gmail via OAuth only. No passwords shared. - Cost controls: cheap model for frequent checks, stronger model for deep research, monthly spend cap, and alert if cost spikes. - Error alerts if anything stops working. DELIVERY - Phase 1: Gmail + Telegram + market alerts. Phase 2: WhatsApp (2-way). Phase 3: voice calls. Milestone payments (30/40/30). - Handover: documentation, video walkthrough, 2 weeks free bug fixing. PLEASE REPLY WITH - Similar past work (WhatsApp bots, Vapi, crypto data agents) - Timeline per phase and fixed price per phase - Expected monthly running cost (APIs, WhatsApp, calls) - Any limits you foresee (WhatsApp approval, India calling)

opportunities.title: Field Sales Executive — Visit Boutiques in Hyderabad, Demo a Simple App
opportunities.description: Field Sales Executive — Visit Boutiques in Hyderabad, Demo a Simple App CommentCart (by TGS LLC) is hiring a field sales executive in Hyderabad, Telangana. CommentCart is a software tool for boutiques and Instagram sellers: when a customer comments a word like 'price' or 'link' on a seller's Instagram post, it instantly sends the buying link by DM. It runs on Meta's official API and costs sellers a flat Rs 999 or Rs 1999/month. Your job: visit 15–20 boutiques, saree shops, jewellery and kids-wear stores per day across Hyderabad (Koti, Kukatpally, Dilsukhnagar, Secunderabad, Jubilee Hills, Kondapur), give owners a 5-minute live demo on your phone, help interested owners start a free trial on the spot (~15 minutes), and send a simple daily report on WhatsApp each evening. Must have: Telugu fluent, working Hindi, basic English; own two-wheeler + smartphone + driving licence; field-sales experience visiting shops (Paytm, Pine Labs, PhonePe, Zomato, insurance, FMCG or similar); working knowledge of Instagram. Pay: fixed base salary Rs 5,000/month PLUS bounties — Rs 500 per Starter customer who pays month 1, Rs 1,000 per Growth customer who pays month 1, plus Rs 250 per customer on month 2. Base paid monthly, bounties paid weekly every Monday. At 20 paying customers/month, total earnings Rs 15,000–25,000+, no cap on bounties. Rules: no false promises to shop owners; never ask for or type a customer's Instagram password; never collect cash or card details. To apply, message: your name, areas of Hyderabad you know best, past sales jobs, and current monthly income + expectation.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40819449, publicado hace 5 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: INR 100 - 400.

opportunities.title: 100% Automated Hands-Free & Bulletproof WooCommerce Store: euromalls.com
opportunities.description: Project Title: 100% Automated Hands-Free & Bulletproof Pan-European WooCommerce Store: WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM Project Description: PRIMARY GOAL: A 100% AUTOMATED, HANDS-FREE, BULLETPROOF ONLINE STORE FOR WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM We are building WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM into a 100% Automated, Hands-Free, Bulletproof Pan-European Online Digital Shopping Mall requiring ZERO manual intervention from the moment a customer clicks "Buy" on WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM to supplier payment, warehouse dispatch, customs/tax compliance, and tracking delivery. WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM serves ALL EU Member States, ALL Non-EU European Countries across the European continent, ALL European Special Fiscal Territories, Islands, and Remote Areas. CURRENT PHASE & FUTURE SCALABILITY ROADMAP FOR WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM: Immediate Phase Deployment: On top of all products currently live on WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM, we are immediately injecting approximately 240,000+ new active SKUs: 90,000+ from DropXL, 50,000+ from Syncee, and 100,000+ from CJ Dropshipping, alongside our Spanish local supplier integrations. Future Progressive Scaling (600K to 1,000,000 SKUs): We will NOT load 1 million SKUs all at once onto WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM. We will scale progressively from our current base + 240K+ SKUs up to 600,000–1,000,000 active SKUs on WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM as we onboard additional suppliers in the future. Therefore, your architecture, database indexing, self-hosted search engine, and VPS/Dedicated hosting recommendation for WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM must handle today's 240K+ catalog smoothly while being 100% ready to scale to 1M SKUs without rebuilding WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM. MANDATORY PRE-WORK RULE: ZERO ALTERATION & FULL BACKUP FOR WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM Everything currently live on WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM, including existing products, pages, design, menus, plugins, settings, and existing data, is STRICTLY OFF-LIMITS. Do NOT delete, overwrite, or alter any existing content on WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM. Before touching anything on WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM, you MUST create and deliver a verified Full Off-Site Backup of WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM covering all files, database, and server snapshot. 7 MANDATORY TECHNICAL BLOCKS FOR WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM: BULLETPROOF INFRASTRUCTURE, ZERO LOCAL IMAGES & $0-COST SEARCH ENGINE: ZERO product images may be stored locally on WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM hosting to protect server inodes. Render all images on WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM externally via supplier CDN URLs or Cloudflare R2 / Amazon S3. Enable WooCommerce HPOS, Redis Object Cache, MySQL indexing, and Nginx/OpenLiteSpeed + PHP tuning on WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM for page loads under 1.5 seconds across our 240K+ immediate catalog and future 1M SKU expansion. Install a $0-license, self-hosted Open-Source search engine via Docker—specifically Typesense, Meilisearch, or OpenSearch/Elasticsearch—with strict RAM isolation from MariaDB to power search under 50ms and instant category/attribute filtering on WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM. Provide a clear hosting recommendation of exact VPS/Dedicated specs suitable for WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM with today's 240K+ SKUs and seamlessly upgradable to 600K–1M SKUs. HANDS-FREE MULTI-SUPPLIER CATALOG INJECTION & STAGGERED CRON SYNC: Inject 100% active eligible catalogs on top of existing WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM products: 90,000+ SKUs from DropXL for Spain domestic delivery ONLY, 50,000+ SKUs from Syncee Spain and EU warehouses, 100,000+ SKUs from CJ Dropshipping EU and China warehouses, plus our Spanish suppliers BigBuy, Nova Engel, Megasur, and Vinopremier. Disable wp-cron.php and configure staggered Linux Server Cron Jobs every 2 hours in micro-batches. Zero-stock items must hide or disable on WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM within 60 minutes. AUTOMATED FRONT-END DELIVERY BADGES NEAR ADD TO CART ON WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM: Syncee Spain, BigBuy, Nova Engel, Megasur, Vinopremier: " Fast Delivery: 24/48h" CJ Europe Warehouses & Syncee EU outside Spain: " Express Shipping: Delivery in 2-5 days (Europe Warehouse)" CJ China Warehouse: " International Shipping: Delivery in 15-20 days (China)" PAN-EUROPEAN GEOGRAPHIC LOCKS & VAT/OSS/EXPORT ROUTING: DropXL is strictly locked to SPAIN only on WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM. Any non-Spanish checkout on WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM, whether single or mixed cart, must block and display: "This product is not available for shipping outside Spain." All other suppliers on WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM must remain open across ALL EU and Non-EU European countries, islands, and European special territories serviced by supplier couriers. BULLETPROOF PRICING ENGINE & EXACT SUPPLIER SHIPPING RATES: Checkout shipping charged to the customer on WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM MUST match the exact live shipping rate returned by the supplier API, plus any Island or Remote Area surcharges. Exact 5-Step Pricing Formula for WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM: STEP 1 — Cumulative Base Cost: Cumulative Cost = Supplier Wholesale Cost + Exact Supplier API Shipping + Island or Remote Surcharges. STEP 2 — Cross-Border Advanced VAT Protection: IF shipping from outside Spain via CJ EU or Syncee EU AND the buyer is outside Spain, multiply Cumulative Cost by 1.21 for non-ROI/VIES VAT protection. STEP 3 — Payment Gateway & Processing Fee Absorption (3.5% + €0.30 fixed buffer): Inflated Base = (Cumulative Cost + 0.30) / (1 - 0.035) STEP 4 — Net Tiered Profit Markup Matrix (Applied to Inflated Base): €0.00 to €50.00: Multiply by 1.35 (35% Net Margin) €50.01 to €100.00: Multiply by 1.25 (25% Net Margin) €100.01 to €500.00: Multiply by 1.15 (15% Net Margin) €500.01 to €1,000.00: Multiply by 1.10 (10% Net Margin) €1,000.01 to €10,000.00: Multiply by 1.04 (4% Net Margin) STEP 5 — Dynamic Destination VAT / Export Tax Engine: For EU buyers, add exact destination EU VAT. For Non-EU European countries and ALL European Special Fiscal Territories—such as Canary Islands, Ceuta, Melilla, Heligoland, Livigno, Campione d'Italia, Åland Islands, Mount Athos, Büsingen am Hochrhein, French Overseas Departments, and all other out-of-VAT European special territories—strip VAT to 0% and inject live DUA/Customs clearance duty into the shipping/duty line item. Bulletproof Pre-Capture Kill Switch: Abort checkout on WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM and alert admin if net revenue ever drops below total costs. ADDRESS AUTO-COMPLETE & POSTCODE MISMATCH LOCK: Integrate Google Places or Loqate postal validation on WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM checkout. Block the "Place Order" button immediately if Country, City, Address, and Postcode do not match, such as selecting Spain with Madrid and postcode 08001. 100% HANDS-FREE CUSTOMER-FUNDED INSTANT SUPPLIER PAYMENT & FULFILLMENT LOOP: CRITICAL FINANCIAL RULE: Use the customer's incoming checkout payment directly via Stripe Connect Split Payments, Destination Charges, or automated instant settlement webhooks to pay the supplier's wholesale and shipping cost instantaneously. ONLY our clean net profit margin reaches WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM's bank account with zero capital outlay from us. Multi-supplier carts on WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM must split customer funds across each supplier automatically, push orders via API immediately, and sync tracking numbers back to mark orders "Completed" on WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM with automated emails and invoices—100% hands-free with zero human clicks. REALISTIC TIMELINE & BUDGET EXPECTATION: We know building a 100% automated, hands-free, bulletproof store on WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM requires 40 to 50 hours of active senior engineering over 10 to 14 calendar days. Bids promising unrealistic 15-hour delivery or copy-paste quotes will be rejected immediately. Payment will be structured across 4 verified technical milestones tied strictly to live acceptance tests on WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM. MANDATORY BIDDING FILTER: Start your bid with "WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM-1M" and state: Confirmation of full pre-work backup and zero alteration of existing products, pages, or design on WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM. Exact active engineering hours and total delivery days for this 240K+ SKU phase on WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM. Chosen $0-cost self-hosted search engine and RAM isolation method. Recommended hosting/VPS hardware specs for WWW.EUROMALLS.EU.COM with today's 240K+ SKUs and how it scales cleanly to 600K–1M SKUs. Exact method to execute 100% hands-free, instant customer-funded split payouts to suppliers. Concrete proof of 100K+ SKU bulletproof WooCommerce automation builds. Skills Required: WooCommerce, WordPress, API Integration, PHP, MySQL, Linux, Docker, Elasticsearch, Stripe Connect Split Payments, PayPal Split Payments, Payment Gateway Integration

opportunities.title: Home Care Packaging Design
opportunities.description: I need a skilled FMCG packaging designer to develop a full visual identity and print-ready artwork for an entire line of household cleaning products. The range spans laundry detergent, dishwashing liquid, multi-purpose and bathroom cleaners, plus a few body-care SKUs that sit under the same brand umbrella. All cleaners will be sold in HDPE or PET bottles, with refill options offered in stand-up or spout pouches, so the graphics must translate seamlessly between rigid bottles and flexible packaging. I already have the dielines for both formats; what I need is a compelling, shelf-impacting design system that ties the whole family together while clearly differentiating each variant. Please send a detailed project proposal outlining your creative approach, milestones, estimated turnaround and revision policy. Attach any relevant portfolio pieces that show experience with similar bottle and pouch formats; I’m especially interested in work you’ve done for other FMCG or detergent brands. Deliverables expected: • Master design concept covering colour palette, typography and iconography • Front and back label layouts for each SKU, finalised in Adobe Illustrator (CMYK) • Print-ready PDFs with bleed, cutter guides and colour call-outs for both bottle labels and refill pouches • 3D mock-ups or high-resolution renders of each pack for presentation and e-commerce use Files should be fully editable, with linked fonts and images supplied. Designs will be signed off once they pass a printability check and accurately reflect the brand strategy discussed at kick-off. I’m ready to move quickly once I review the right proposal.

opportunities.title: Full-Stack Developer Required to Build Multi-Tenant SaaS CRM & ERP Platform
opportunities.description: **Project Type:** Development from Scratch **Platform:** Web SaaS + Mobile PWA **Engagement:** Fixed Price **Budget:** Open to Proposals ### Project Overview We are looking for an experienced full-stack developer or agency to design, develop, test, and deploy MYEVCRM, a complete cloud-based CRM, ERP, and business operations platform. Initially, the software will support EV infrastructure companies managing EPC projects, charger installation, commissioning, AMC, field services, finance, procurement, inventory, workforce, and charger monitoring. Our objective is to launch MYEVCRM commercially as a multi-tenant SaaS product with subscription plans, white-label branding, customizable modules, and secure independent client workspaces. The software must be developed from scratch, with a modern, user-friendly interface and complete source-code ownership. ### 1. Multi-Tenant SaaS & White-Label - Multiple independent companies with secure data isolation. - SaaS Super Admin and Company Admin dashboards. - Role-based permissions and multiple branches. - Trial, monthly, and annual subscriptions. - Module-based access and user licensing. - Client-specific logos, themes, and login pages. - Custom domains/subdomains. - Configurable menus, forms, and dashboards. - Branded documents and reports. - Tenant onboarding, activation, suspension, and data export. ### 2. CRM & Sales Management Lead management, customer records, sales pipeline, opportunities, follow-ups, quotations, proposals, contracts, sales orders, revenue forecasting, and sales dashboards. Leads must be convertible into projects or service contracts. ### 3. EV EPC Project Management - Multi-client, multi-project, and multi-site management. - Site surveys and readiness checklists. - BOQ, costing, budgeting, and margin analysis. - Vendor quotation comparison and work orders. - Project schedules and milestones. - Material planning and allocation. - Installation and commissioning tracking. - Daily Progress Reports (DPR). - Site photos and quality inspections. - Multi-level approvals. - WCC, HOTO, and project closure. - Project profitability and billing readiness. ### 4. AMC & Field Service Management - Charger and equipment asset registration. - Serial-number tracking and warranty management. - AMC contracts and renewals. - Preventive and breakdown maintenance. - Service ticket management and assignment. - SLA/TAT tracking and escalations. - Technician scheduling and service checklists. - Spare parts consumption. - Fault history and Root Cause Analysis. - Customer acknowledgement and ticket closure. - AMC performance and profitability dashboards. ### 5. Workforce & Technician Management The platform must manage four workforce categories: 1. Internal Team – Company employees. 2. Partner Internal Team – Partner company employees. 3. Freelance Technicians – Independent field technicians. 4. Local Vendors – Civil, electrical, and installation contractors. Features include onboarding, skills, certifications, geographic coverage, availability, job allocation, attendance, GPS check-in where permitted, task progress, photo evidence, quality checks, performance ratings, rate cards, freelancer payments, vendor settlements, and category-specific permissions. ### 6. Procurement & Vendor Management Vendor onboarding, RFQs, quotation comparison, purchase requisitions, POs, approval workflows, vendor rate cards, agreements, invoices, payment tracking, outstanding reports, and performance analysis. ### 7. Inventory & Asset Management Material masters, warehouses, stock inward/outward, transfers, project allocation, technician stock, serial-number tracking, spare parts, defective materials, returns, reorder levels, stock valuation, and asset lifecycle management. ### 8. Finance & Commercial Management Customer invoicing, vendor payables, receivables, payment tracking, GST invoice fields, project budgets, actual expenses, site-wise profitability, department P&L, gross margins, credit/debit notes, financial approvals, and outstanding dashboards. ### 9. EV Charger CMS Integration This is an important module for charging infrastructure monitoring and profitability. Required features: - Charger registration and CMS integration. - Live online/offline/charging/fault status. - Charging session history. - Electricity consumption in kWh. - Charger utilization, uptime, and downtime. - Charger fault monitoring and service ticket creation. - Charging tariffs and revenue. - Electricity purchase cost and operating expenses. - Site-wise and charger-wise profitability. - ROI and investment payback calculations. - Client-specific monitoring dashboards. - Daily, monthly, and yearly analytics. Support compatible OCPP 1.6J/2.0.1 where feasible. Historical CSV/Excel imports must also be supported. Live and imported data must be clearly differentiated. ### 10. Third-Party Integrations Future integration support for Tally, SAP, Zoho, Salesforce, other CRM/ERP platforms, accounting applications, and charger CMS. Support CSV, Excel, and XML import/export. Free APIs may be used when reliable and commercially permitted. Paid APIs or recurring third-party services require prior approval. All dependencies must be documented. ### 11. Customization & Automation - No-code form and custom field builder. - Configurable checklists and statuses. - Approval workflow builder. - Multi-level approvals. - SLA and escalation automation. - Notifications and reminders. - Custom report builder. - Configurable dashboards and widgets. ### 12. Documents & Reporting Centralized document management with upload, preview, download, version history, permissions, and audit logs. Dashboards for management, sales, EPC, AMC, workforce, finance, procurement, inventory, charger monitoring, consumption, revenue, and ROI. Reports must support filters and Excel/CSV/PDF export. ### 13. Mobile PWA & Offline Features The application must work on desktops, tablets, and mobile devices. Field engineers, freelancers, and vendors should be able to view jobs, update progress, complete checklists, upload photos, record materials, submit reports, and capture customer acknowledgements. Selected field workflows must support offline data capture with secure synchronization and conflict handling. ### 14. UI/UX Requirements Clean, modern, fast, and intuitive interface. Simple navigation, minimum clicks, easy forms, clear status indicators, responsive dashboards, and role-specific screens. UI/UX wireframes must be approved before development. ### 15. Technology & Security Open to suitable technology recommendations. Preferred options: React/Next.js, Laravel/Django/Node.js, PostgreSQL, Git, and cloud/VPS hosting. Mandatory security includes tenant data isolation, role-based access, secure authentication, server-side authorization, audit trails, encrypted communication, secure uploads, automated backups, recovery testing, and protection against common vulnerabilities. ### 16. Development Milestones Phase 1: Requirements, architecture, database, and UI/UX. Phase 2: Multi-tenant SaaS foundation and permissions. Phase 3: CRM and EPC management. Phase 4: AMC, workforce, and vendor modules. Phase 5: Procurement, inventory, and finance. Phase 6: White-label, subscriptions, and automation. Phase 7: Charger CMS, monitoring, and ROI analytics. Phase 8: Testing, deployment, and training. Phase 9: Complete source-code handover. Development must follow approved milestones with working demonstrations and acceptance testing. ### 17. Mandatory Source Code Ownership **Complete source-code and IP handover is non-negotiable.** Developer must provide: - Complete frontend and backend source code. - Database schema and migrations. - Git repository and commit history. - UI/UX design files. - Deployment scripts and configurations. - Integration code and documentation. - Technical and user manuals. - Testing and backup procedures. - Hosting and administrator access. - Third-party license details. Git repository and hosting should be under our ownership from Day 1. All newly developed project-specific IP must be transferred under the agreement. We must be free to modify, maintain, and commercialize the product independently. Final payment will depend on successful deployment, testing, and complete handover. ### 18. Testing & Support Functional, integration, security, performance, permission, and tenant-isolation testing are mandatory. Include a post-launch bug-fixing warranty and separate maintenance/support quotation. ### 19. Proposal Requirements Please provide: 1. Similar SaaS/CRM/ERP project examples. 2. Recommended technology stack. 3. Multi-tenancy and white-label approach. 4. Experience with CMS/OCPP integration. 5. Development team details. 6. Timeline and milestone plan. 7. Module-wise fixed-price quotation. 8. Hosting and recurring cost estimates. 9. Testing and maintenance proposal. 10. Confirmation of complete source-code/IP handover. We need a reliable developer or agency capable of delivering a production-ready commercial SaaS product, not just a prototype. The detailed technical blueprint will be shared with shortlisted developers. **Start your proposal with "MYEVCRM SAAS" and provide relevant project examples.**

opportunities.title: AI SEO Article Automation Tool
opportunities.description: Title: Build an AI Article Automation for an SEO Agency (Claude API + Bulk Brief Processing) About the Project I’m an SEO content manager. I produce a large number of articles and blogs each week for clients across Canada and the US in dental, legal, automotive, HVAC, real estate, construction and other industries. I need a simple automation that takes my client briefs and turns them into ready-to-review articles that read naturally and pass AI-detection checks. What the Input Looks Like Briefs arrive in this format, often many at a time: Campaign: 1 Article – 1 https://karmadentistry.ca/ Words Length: It should be at least 450 Words Primary Keyword: Cosmetic dentistry near me Secondary Keyword: Cosmetic dentistry near me in Mississauga Our Targeted Website: https://karmadentistry.ca/smile-rehabilitation/ A batch can contain several articles (450+ words) and blogs (250+ words) for one or more clients. What the Automation Must Do Parse briefs in bulk. I paste in or upload a full campaign, and the tool pulls out the client URL, word count, primary and secondary keywords, and target page for each piece. Research the client. It fetches the target page and homepage and pulls real business details (services, location, what makes them different). If a page doesn’t load, it should flag that clearly. It must never make up prices, stats, certifications or reviews. Generate the article using the Claude API, following my style rules: Warm, conversational, human tone, with contractions, rhetorical questions and varied sentence length No colons, semicolons, hyphens or dashes in the body copy Primary keyword in the title and worked in naturally, using synonyms instead of repeating it Bold subheadings for articles, a short bullet list under one or two of them, and a closing call to action Canadian English by default, with a setting to switch to American English for US clients Careful, consultation-focused wording for dental, medical, legal and aesthetics clients Run quality checks: word count, banned punctuation, keyword placement and repeated phrases. Check AI detection. It should connect to an AI-detection API (ZeroGPT, Originality.ai or similar). If a piece scores above my threshold (usually 5%), it rewrites automatically and checks again. Export the output to Google Docs or Word (one doc per campaign is fine), with each piece labelled by its keyword and ending with its word count. Nice to Have A simple interface (a web form, Google Sheet or desktop app) so I don’t have to touch code Saved style templates for each client A log of detection scores for each article Deliverables A working tool, plus source code that I own A short setup guide or video showing how to run it One round of testing and fixes on a real campaign of 5 to 10 articles

opportunities.title: Server-Side GTM, Stape, Magento 2 Tracking Specialist – Advanced GA4 & Meta CAPI
opportunities.description: I am looking for a highly skilled Tracking Specialist to completely overhaul and configure a reliable, accurate, and fully optimized tracking architecture for a luxury e-commerce brand. CRITICAL REQUIREMENT: You MUST have proven experience implementing advanced tracking within the Magento 2 ecosystem. I have previously hired highly-rated tracking experts whose implementations failed because they applied generic Shopify/WordPress approaches that were incompatible with Magento’s architecture, particularly regarding Content Security Policies (CSP), checkout functionality, and DataLayer structure. Please do not apply unless you have hands-on experience with Magento 2 checkout security, tracking integrations, and third-party extensions. My Tech Stack Platform: Magento 2 (v2.4.8) DataLayer: Magefan GTM Extension Consent Management: Anowave Cookie Consent Mode V2 Server-Side: Stape.io & Google Tag Manager (Web + Server containers) Destinations: GA4 & Meta CAPI Infrastructure: Cloudflare & PayU (3D Secure redirects) The Scope of Work I need a highly accurate, fully compatible tracking system with reliable data transmission between the browser, server-side GTM, Meta, and GA4. Your responsibilities will include: 1. Flawless Deduplication & Routing Fix the current split-routing architecture and establish a consistent event-tracking structure. Browser and server events must use properly synchronized event_id values to ensure reliable deduplication in Meta Events Manager, while maintaining accurate GA4 tracking without duplicate events. 2. Server-Side Cookie Persistence (EMQ) Properly configure the Stape Data Client and cookie handling to ensure identifiers such as _fbp, _fbc, _dcid, and FPIDP are correctly generated, transmitted, mapped, and persisted where applicable, in accordance with Anowave consent settings. Cookie lifetimes should be optimized within browser and privacy restrictions to maximize Event Match Quality (EMQ). 3. Complete Funnel Tracking Ensure all critical upper-funnel and lower-funnel events are accurately tracked, properly structured, and reliably transmitted: session_start, page_view, view_item, add_to_cart, begin_checkout (Meta: InitiateCheckout), add_shipping_info, add_payment_info, and purchase. Ensure the appropriate corresponding events are correctly mapped to Meta CAPI, with consistent event parameters and values. 4. Auto-Mapping & Data Hashing Ensure the Meta CAPI tag correctly handles auto-mapping for dynamic values, currencies, product information, and item arrays, without data loss or incorrect attribution. All available customer identifiers (email, phone, etc.) must be properly normalized and SHA-256 hashed where required before transmission to Meta. Implement reliable event handling to minimize data loss caused by network delays or temporary transmission failures. 5. Magento CSP & Checkout Handling You must understand how Magento 2's Content Security Policy (CSP) can restrict tracking requests, particularly on checkout and order success pages. I have a dedicated Magento backend developer on my team. Your responsibility is to identify and provide the exact domains/endpoints (e.g., scv.mydomain.com) that must be allowlisted through Magento's csp_whitelist.xml, where necessary. 6. Cloudflare Compatibility Ensure the GTM Server container receives the correct visitor IP address (e.g., via CF-Connecting-IP headers) when Cloudflare's proxy (orange cloud) is enabled. Identify any Cloudflare WAF, proxy, or security configurations that could interfere with tracking requests, and recommend appropriate exceptions where necessary. Payment & Quality Assurance Terms I am extremely detail-oriented and expect a thoroughly tested, professional implementation. This is a fixed-price contract, and payment will be released ONLY after the complete implementation has been successfully tested and verified. We will verify that: All critical funnel events are accurately received, properly structured, and consistently reported in GA4 and Meta. Browser and server-side Meta events are correctly matched and deduplicated, without unresolved configuration or deduplication warnings. The purchase event fires reliably and only once per transaction, including orders involving external 3D Secure payment redirects (PayU). Consent settings, cookie persistence, event parameters, and customer identifiers work correctly throughout the entire tracking process. To Apply Please start your proposal by answering these two technical questions: How do you handle Magento 2 CSP restrictions that may block tracking requests or prevent the Purchase event from being transmitted correctly on the success page? How do you ensure that Anowave Cookie Consent settings are correctly communicated to the Stape Data Client so that server-side identifiers and cookies are properly stored and maintained only when consent permits? I am looking for a genuine Magento 2 tracking expert who values precision, reliability, and attention to detail. If you have the required experience and can deliver a thoroughly tested implementation, I look forward to working with you.

opportunities.title: English Buildings Laser-Cut Kits
opportunities.description: I'm seeking creative talent to design 3D resin printable and laser-cut kits of English buildings for hobby model makers. I want to own these files, to be able to engrave and cut myslef. Both "full size" meaning a complete building, and half relief buildings to go up against a wall. I need to be able to get inside the buildings to add my own lights some detials, clearly they will need painting by myself or people I sell these pprinted or wooden kits too. I will also be adding lighting to the interior. Requirements: - Represent a mix of building types: historic landmarks (castles, churches), traditional homes, Retail outlets, hotels and some village and city structures. - Design detailed models with separate components for doors, windows, and roofs. - Ensure precision and quality suitable for intricate assembly. -hiding the connection parts for each wall, floor etc as much as possble, in brick and or block works. Ideal Skills and Experience: - Proficiency in design software for laser cutting. - Experience in architectural modeling. - Attention to detail and craftsmanship. I am able to supply some images of things I am looking for as well from time to time. Looking forward to your innovative designs!

opportunities.title: Reconstrucción PDF Escaneado Profesional
opportunities.description: Tengo un PDF de dos páginas que hoy luce claramente escaneado. Necesito transformarlo por completo para que aparente ser un documento digital original, listo para imprimir sin rastro de sombras, manchas ni pérdida de definición. Qué espero: • Reconstrucción visual total: corrige perspectiva, bordes y alineación, reescribe o limpia el texto para lograr nitidez absoluta y, si corresponde, vuelve a componer tablas, imágenes o sellos. • Resultado final en el mismo tamaño y resolución que el archivo fuente, entregado en PDF de alta calidad. • Preservación fiel de todo el contenido (texto, gráficos y estilos) con aspecto pulcro y profesional. Tu perfil ideal: – Dominio probado en retoque y restauración de documentos escaneados. – Experiencia demostrable realizando trabajos similares; muéstrame ejemplos concretos en tu propuesta. Entregables: 1. PDF final totalmente reconstruido y listo para impresión. 2. (Opcional) Archivo editable de apoyo si tu flujo de trabajo lo permite. Quedo atento a tu experiencia y a un breve resumen de cómo abordarías la reconstrucción de estas dos páginas.

opportunities.title: Ongoing SolidWorks 3D Design -- 3
opportunities.description: I’m looking to build a steady collaboration with a SolidWorks specialist who can jump in whenever new projects land on my desk. My day-to-day need is clear: 3D part and assembly design for mechanical parts and full machine assemblies. I will supply either a clean 3D SolidWorks model that needs refinement or a quick hand sketch with key dimensions; you turn that input into fully detailed, parametric assemblies ready for manufacturing. Typical workflow • Receive my reference (model or sketch) • Create or update the parametric part files and mate them into a clean, structured assembly • Generate manufacturing-ready drawings with views, dimensions, tolerances, and a basic BOM • Return the native SolidWorks files, STEP/IGES for sharing, and PDFs of the 2D drawings Acceptance criteria • Feature tree remains fully editable and logically organized • All mates solve without errors; no suppressed features in the final assembly • Drawings follow ISO or ANSI standards (I’ll specify per job) and clearly communicate GD&T where needed Quick communication and the ability to handle iterative feedback are more valuable to me than sheer speed. If you’re comfortable owning the 3D design side so I can focus on overall project management, let’s start with a small assignment and grow from there.

opportunities.title: Boost Dairy Orders via Social Media
opportunities.description: I run a local dairy brand that has already built trust with walk-in customers; now I need that same loyalty to translate into steady online orders and recurring home-delivery subscriptions. My priority is clear: drive measurable sales through Instagram, Facebook, and the order-taking power of WhatsApp. Here’s what I’m looking for: engaging, on-brand content that highlights our curated subscription boxes and flexible delivery bundles, paired with targeted ad campaigns and smart WhatsApp funnels that turn followers into paying customers. Creative reels, carousel posts, short video stories, and timely offers should all point directly to our checkout links or chat-to-order button. To keep things straightforward, I’ll judge success by two metrics—growth in completed online checkouts and the uptick in weekly delivery sign-ups—so please be comfortable setting baseline numbers, tracking them, and optimising as we go. If you have proven experience scaling e-commerce sales for FMCG or food brands on these exact channels, I’d love to see quick examples when we start chatting. Let’s turn social engagement into cartons on doorsteps.

opportunities.title: Unity 3D Multiplayer Grocery Game
opportunities.description: I’m building a cartoon-styled deception game in Unity where five online players share a single match: two play as store hunters while three pose as criminals carrying out secret missions before making a clean escape. The action unfolds inside a modern, clean supermarket with wide aisles, so visual clarity and polished 3D assets are important. FIRST PLAYABLE MILESTONE The very first thing I need is the grocery store map with functioning AI customers. These NPC shoppers must: • Pick up items from shelves • Use the checkout counters before leaving They should wander convincingly, queue when necessary, and generally create enough foot-traffic to make spotting the three criminals difficult for the hunters. Solid path-finding, simple state machines, and lightweight animation loops will be key here. ONWARD ROADMAP (context only) Once the AI-rich store environment feels alive, I plan to layer in the 5-player online roles, mission logic, detection and escape mechanics, and eventually port to multiple platforms. If we collaborate well on the prototype, there’s plenty more work ahead. Please send a brief note on your Unity multiplayer and AI experience, along with an estimated budget and timeline for delivering this first milestone. I’m ready to start as soon as we align on scope and schedule.

opportunities.title: WhatsApp Mould Repair Intake Automation
opportunities.description: I want to let my customers open mould-repair tickets straight from WhatsApp — in English, Hindi, Bengali or even Hinglish — without me touching any code. When they type “repair”, a guided form should appear, ask for: • mould number • company name and contact name • pickup address if needed • machine details and urgency level • a short defect description plus photos or video Once they hit send, the system must: 1. push every answer into a Google Sheet (one row per ticket) 2. create a uniquely numbered, one-page A4 PDF Job Card using the same data and attach the photos inside or as links 3. deliver that PDF instantly to both our office WhatsApp number and our chosen email address(es) — customers should not receive it 4. store the PDF in Google Drive for easy lookup Tech stack I would like to keep: WhatsApp Cloud API, n8n for the flows, and Google Sheets / Drive for storage. I have no prior coding experience, so I need you to build, test and document the whole workflow end-to-end, then walk me through it in a short hand-over session so I can add fields or change the email later. Please tell me about similar automations you have shipped with n8n or WhatsApp Cloud API and outline how many days you will need for: • initial setup • live testing with me on WhatsApp • final tweaks, documentation and basic training I will shortlist freelancers who demonstrate hands-on experience integrating WhatsApp Cloud API, dynamic PDF generation and Google Sheets.

opportunities.title: AI Children's Tale Video Creation
opportunities.description: I own a channel that repurposes public-domain children’s tales, myths, and fairy-tales into relaxing, long-form content. The next step is a series of videos—each running a full hour or more—ready for YouTube, TikTok, Facebook, and Instagram. Here’s what has to happen: • Select or confirm a public-domain story in the children’s/folklore space. • Craft a concise, engaging summary script that fills 60+ minutes when narrated. • Generate a natural-sounding AI voice-over (male or female—whatever best suits the tale). • Pair the narration with continuous, royalty-free or AI-generated scene changes so the visuals evolve steadily instead of staying static. • Edit, mix, and render in 1080p (horizontal for YouTube/Facebook, vertical for TikTok/Instagram). • Deliver the final MP4s plus separate audio and caption files so I can repurpose if needed. Any of the common AI toolchains—ChatGPT or Claude for summarising, ElevenLabs for voice, Midjourney/Stable Diffusion, Pika, Runway, CapCut, Premiere, or DaVinci for editing—are fine. What matters is a soothing flow: clear narration, smooth scene transitions, zero copyright risk, and a total runtime that never dips below one hour. Once the first video is approved, the same workflow can roll out to an ongoing series.

opportunities.description: I’m consolidating several datasets for a land-management project and need both sides of the geospatial workflow completed in one go. First, I’ll supply scanned cadastral sheets, survey notes, and other reference files; from those, please digitize every required feature—property boundaries and parcels, road and building footprints, plus rivers, vegetation classes, and other land-use areas—into clean, topologically sound vector layers. Each layer should carry clear, well-structured attribute tables and share a common, clearly documented CRS that will drop straight into ArcGIS or QGIS. In parallel, you’ll receive a batch of overlapping drone photos. Your task is to process them into a single, high-resolution orthomosaic that aligns perfectly with the new vector data. I’m not looking for 3D models this time; just a crisp, georeferenced stitched image suited for further mapping and measurement work. Please maintain sub-meter positional accuracy and document the full processing chain (software, control points, QA checks) so the results are reproducible. Deliverables • GeoPackage or Shapefile set containing all digitized layers • GeoTIFF orthomosaic, tiled if necessary for size • Metadata report detailing CRS, source references, accuracy assessment, and processing steps Provide a brief note on the tools you intend to use (e.g., ArcGIS Pro, QGIS, Agisoft Metashape, Pix4D) and an estimated turnaround time, and we can get started right away.

opportunities.title: AI-Powered Telegram Support Bot
opportunities.description: I need a Telegram bot that can step in whenever a user asks a question and instantly craft a helpful reply through an AI assistant rather than a fixed FAQ sheet. The user’s message should pass to the AI back-end (OpenAI, Claude, or any comparable model you recommend) and the generated answer must return to Telegram in a clear, friendly tone while keeping conversation context intact. How I picture the flow • User poses a question in a group, channel, or DM • Bot forwards it to the AI service, waits for completion • AI response is sent back to the user, tagged or threaded appropriately • Bot records basic interaction stats for me (/stats) Core expectations • Clean, reliable integration with Telegram Bot API • Context handling so back-and-forth conversations feel natural • Simple admin commands (/enable, /disable, /reset, /stats) • Secure management of all API keys via env vars or a config file • Deployment instructions for a small VPS or serverless setup I place high value on seeing your past work—especially bots or AI integrations you’ve already rolled out—so please include links or brief descriptions in your proposal. Code readability, meaningful comments, and a concise README are must-haves because I’ll want to fine-tune prompts and settings on my own later. If you can outline how you’d stage the milestones and mention any external services or libraries you plan to rely on, that will help me lock in a decision quickly.

opportunities.title: 3D Printable Prototype CAD Design
opportunities.description: Job Title: Reverse Engineering / Class-A Surface Designer – Two-Wheeler Body Panels (Scan-to-CAD) Project Overview We have 3D scan data (mesh) of the body panels of a Honda Activa 6G scooter. We need these converted into clean, editable CAD surfaces, then a redesigned outer skin built to a client’s design, while still fitting the existing chassis and neighbouring panels. Scope of Work Clean and prepare the scan mesh (noise removal, alignment, hole filling). Rebuild accurate NURBS surfaces and solids from the mesh (scan-to-CAD), with deviation analysis against the scan. Preserve all mating and mounting geometry exactly: clip points, screw bosses, panel edges, and gap/flush relationships with adjacent panels. Redesign the outer visible surface to the client’s reference design [sketches / renders / reference images will be provided]. Check panel gaps, clearances, and continuity (G1/G2 where required). opportunities.title: Urgent RCC Structural Detailers Needed
opportunities.description: Experienced Structural Detailers Required – RCCAD / AutoCAD / Revit | Urgent Project Project Type: Freelance / Part-Time / Project-Based Work Mode: Remote Project Availability: Immediate Minimum Engagement Period: 3 Months Project Overview We are seeking experienced freelance structural detailers to support our team on an urgent structural detailing project. We welcome applications from skilled independent freelancers and part-time professionals with proven experience in structural shop drawing preparation, reinforcement detailing, and coordination. The selected professionals will work on the assigned project scope and coordinate with our team to ensure accurate and timely delivery. Scope of Work The project involves the following activities: 1. Formwork Shop Drawings: Preparation of detailed formwork drawings for individual structural blocks. 2. Reinforcement Shop Drawings: Preparation of detailed reinforcement drawings for various structural elements. 3. Bar Bending Schedules (BBS): Preparation of reinforcement schedules, including bar marks, shapes, dimensions, and quantities. 4. MEP Coordination: Coordination and incorporation of MEP openings, sleeves, embeds, and penetrations. 5. Coordinate & Grid Integration: Working with EGSA87 coordinates and the project grid system to ensure accurate positioning and alignment. Required Skills & Technical Expertise - Proven experience in structural detailing and shop drawing preparation. - Strong knowledge of RCC formwork and reinforcement detailing. - Practical experience in preparing Bar Bending Schedules (BBS). - Understanding of MEP coordination and structural openings. - Familiarity with EGSA87 coordinates and project grid systems. - Proficiency in RCCAD, AutoCAD, and/or Revit. - Hands-on RCCAD experience for reinforcement detailing and BBS preparation will be an added advantage. - Ability to interpret structural drawings and project specifications independently. Project Availability & Mobilisation This is an urgent project requirement. We are looking for professionals who: - Can start immediately or within a short period after project award. - Can commit to a minimum continuous engagement period of 3 months. - Have sufficient working availability throughout the engagement period to meet project requirements. - Can work independently and coordinate with our technical team when required. - Can maintain high standards of drawing accuracy and quality throughout the project. Please mention your current availability and confirm your ability to commit to the minimum three-month engagement when applying. Application Requirements Interested professionals are requested to share: 1. A brief introduction and relevant professional experience. 2. Previous experience in formwork and reinforcement detailing. 3. Samples of completed structural shop drawings and BBS. 4. Software expertise (RCCAD / AutoCAD / Revit). 5. Current availability and earliest possible mobilisation date. 6. Confirmation of availability for a minimum three-month engagement. Closing Note We are looking forward to collaborating with experienced, reliable, and technically skilled structural detailers who can support this project on an urgent basis. Freelancers and part-time professionals with relevant project experience and the ability to commit for at least three months are encouraged to submit their applications. We look forward to a successful professional collaboration.

opportunities.title: 3D Flight Fare Promo Video
opportunities.description: I need a short 3D commercial that highlights our cheapest flight fares and speaks directly to young adults and students. The spot has to feel fresh and energetic, with one engaging animated character guiding viewers through the savings and a crisp, well-paced voice-over that is easy to understand even on mobile. Where it will appear • Square and vertical cuts for social media ads • Standard 16:9 for YouTube pre-roll and online placements • A silent-loop version for airport and travel-agency screens What I’ll look for in the final hand-off • 25–35 sec 3D animation rendered in 1080p (plus the extra aspect-ratio versions above) • English voice-over mastered and baked into the main edit, plus a clean track for future localisation • Layered project files (Maya, Blender, C4D or similar) and the final compiled video in MP4/H.264 • One round of revisions after first draft to fine-tune visuals, pacing or VO If you have a reel that shows lively character work and clear VO mixing, send it over so we can lock the style quickly and get this fare-promo flying.

opportunities.title: 3D Printed Cigar Tuck Cutter
opportunities.description: I’m developing a hand-powered tuck cutter that lets me press natural tobacco leaf wrappers onto a flat surface and quickly trim them with a clean, curved edge perfect for rolling cigars. I need a CAD design that I can send straight to my 3D-printer—no further tweaking—so attention to tolerances and blade alignment is essential. Because I work exclusively with whole, natural leaves, the geometry must accommodate their slight stretch while still producing a consistent rounded cut. The tool will be operated solely by hand; no clamps, hinges, or tabletop mounts are required, but an ergonomic grip and enough rigidity to prevent flex while pressing are important. Deliverables • Print-ready STL (plus STEP or native Fusion 360/SolidWorks file for future edits) • Exploded view or brief assembly note if multiple printed parts are involved • Recommended material settings (layer height, infill, orientation) to preserve edge sharpness • Confirmation that the cutting profile produces a smooth, curved strip the full width of a cigar wrapper I’ll test the first print and share feedback; quick revisions to fine-tune fit or edge profile may follow. Let’s create a simple, durable cutter that speeds up my rolling workflow and looks good on the bench.

opportunities.title: Long-Term 2D Design Partner
opportunities.description: I’m setting up a three-year collaboration with one versatile designer who can turn a constant stream of ideas, sketches, and mark-ups into crisp, presentation-ready 2D drawings and designs. Most weeks I’ll hand you rough hand-sketches, photo references, or red-lined PDFs and ask for clean, scaled drawings that are accurate enough for engineers yet attractive enough for client decks. The work is varied—one month it may be detailed building layouts, the next a set of technical product diagrams or marketing visuals—so fluency across common 2D toolsets is essential. AutoCAD for precise line work, Adobe Illustrator or Photoshop for polished graphics, and the ability to export everything to whatever final format the project dictates (print-ready PDFs, layered source files, or native CAD) keeps the pipeline flowing smoothly. Communication and consistency matter more than flashy portfolios. I value: • Fast, reliable turnarounds within agreed timelines • Clearly organised layers, styles, and naming conventions • Easy revision cycles: you accept mark-ups, return updated files, and note what changed • A proactive eye for detail—spotting dimension clashes or layout issues before they become problems Although the bulk of the load is 2D, a comfort level with quick 3D mock-ups or renders is a welcome bonus and could grow into a larger part of the role as our product lines evolve. If you’re ready for steady, predictable work and enjoy refining drawings until they’re spot-on, let’s talk about the first assignment and set milestones for the months ahead.

opportunities.title: One Hour Blender Animation Lesson
opportunities.description: In a single, live one-hour session over screen-share, I want to get comfortable with Blender’s animation basics. Blender 5.2 is already installed on my laptop; what I need now is practical, guided practice. The focus of the lesson is creating basic animations—specifically moving and rotating simple objects. Please walk me through the essential workspace controls, keyframing, and the timeline so that by the end of the hour I can confidently set up and play a short object-motion sequence on my own. We can meet through Zoom, Google Meet, or any similar tool that allows screen sharing and clear audio. I’ll share my screen so you can demonstrate each step directly within my own Blender interface and watch me repeat it. By the end of the call, I expect to: • Understand how to navigate the viewport and manipulate objects. • Animate at least one object’s position and rotation from start to finish. • Export or preview the result smoothly. If you have sample .blend files that illustrate object motion, feel free to bring them; otherwise we’ll create a scene from scratch.

opportunities.title: Especialista en Gohighlevel para crear una máquina de ventas y Crm ...
opportunities.description: Se busca un especialista con experiencia comprobable en GoHighLevel para desarrollar una máquina de ventas y CRM integral para una correduría de seguros en Colombia. El objetivo es construir una plataforma robusta que no solo funcione como CRM administrativo, sino que también automatice la captación, calificación y distribución de prospectos, con la capacidad de ser replicada para otras agencias de seguros. Los componentes clave a desarrollar incluyen: 1. Captación y embudo de ventas: - Diseño e implementación de landing pages de calificación y páginas de agradecimiento. - Configuración de formularios conectados a campañas de anuncios en Meta (Facebook/Instagram). - Creación de un pipeline de ventas con etapas definidas: prospecto, contactado, cotizado, negociación, ganado/perdido. 2. Agente de IA para WhatsApp: - Desarrollo de un agente de inteligencia artificial capaz de responder a prospectos en segundos, calificarlos y agendar citas automáticamente. - Implementación de lógica para transferir leads 'calientes' a un asesor humano. 3. Distribución automática de prospectos: - Configuración de un sistema de asignación de leads tipo 'round-robin' o por turnos entre asesores o agentes. - Establecimiento de reglas de distribución basadas en el ramo de seguro (vida, salud, autos, hogar, exequias, etc.), Ubicación geográfica o disponibilidad del asesor. - Asegurar la no duplicación de leads, con notificaciones automáticas vía WhatsApp a los asesores y seguimiento en tiempo real. - Posibilidad de establecer límites de leads por asesor o paquete. 4. CRM de clientes y pólizas: - Creación de fichas de cliente detalladas que incluyan información de pólizas, aseguradora, ramo, vigencia, prima y estado. - Implementación de campos personalizados y alertas de renovación (60, 30 y 15 días antes). - Funcionalidades para el manejo de cartera, incluyendo recordatorios de pago y seguimiento de cobro. 5. Automatizaciones y flujos de trabajo: - Desarrollo de secuencias automatizadas de WhatsApp, SMS y correo electrónico para bienvenida, seguimiento, post-venta, renovación y reactivación. - Configuración de recordatorios de citas (24 horas, 1 hora, 10 minutos antes). - Creación de flujos de correo con plantillas personalizables. 6. Informes y dashboards: - Generación de informes y paneles de control para visualizar leads por fuente, tasa de conversión por etapa, ventas por asesor/ramo, estado de cartera, renovaciones y comisiones. 7. Modelo multi-agencia: - Estructuración del sistema para permitir la creación de subcuentas o 'snapshots' que faciliten la replicación del sistema a otras agencias de seguros, permitiendo la administración independiente de cada una. Se requiere experiencia sólida en la configuración de workflows, pipelines, agentes de IA e integraciones dentro de la plataforma GoHighLevel. Categoría: Programación y Tecnología Subcategoría: Programación Web ¿Cuál es el alcance del proyecto?: Crear un nuevo sitio personalizado

opportunities.title: App móvil venta productos
opportunities.description: Quiero lanzar una aplicación móvil que me permita vender productos físicos de forma sencilla y segura. La idea es que el usuario pueda explorar un catálogo, añadir artículos al carrito, pagar dentro de la app y luego hacer seguimiento de su pedido. Me muevo con rapidez y disfruto de la tecnología, por lo que busco un desarrollo limpio, escalable y bien documentado. Funcionalidades clave • Catálogo con fotos, descripciones y stock en tiempo real • Carrito de compras y proceso de checkout optimizado • Pasarela de pago segura (tarjeta y, si es posible, billeteras digitales) • Notificaciones push para confirmar pedidos y actualizaciones de envío • Panel de administración para gestionar inventario, precios y promociones • Módulo de seguimiento de pedidos con número de guía • Estadísticas básicas de ventas y clientes Alcance técnico Prefiero una solución multiplataforma (Flutter o React Native) para publicar tanto en iOS como en Android, pero acepto propuestas nativas si justifican ventajas claras. El código debe quedar en un repositorio Git, acompañado de instrucciones de despliegue y un breve manual de usuario interno. Entregables 1. Código fuente completo y documentado 2. Build firmada lista para App Store y Google Play 3. Panel de administración funcional (puede ser web) 4. Archivo de configuración y guía de instalación Valoro la comunicación ágil, los commits frecuentes y la posibilidad de añadir funciones extra más adelante (por ejemplo, cupones o programa de fidelidad). Si tienes experiencia en e-commerce móvil y pasarelas de pago, será un plus importante.

opportunities.title: Descompilar y recompilar juego Gamebryo
opportunities.description: Cuento con el ejecutable original de un juego de mi infancia basado en Gamebryo con DirectX 9. Antes de empezar a retocar textos, gráficos o mecánicas, lo primero que necesito es un flujo estable de ingeniería inversa: obtener el código fuente legible, reorganizarlo en un proyecto que compile sin errores y generar un nuevo .exe funcional que se comporte exactamente igual que el original. Proporciono el .exe y los recursos actuales; también tengo identificadas varias DLL asociadas al motor. El objetivo inicial es: • Descompilar completamente el binario y cualquier librería vinculada • Reestructurar y documentar el proyecto de modo que pueda abrirse y compilarse en un entorno moderno (Visual Studio + SDK DirectX 9, por ejemplo) • Entregar un build reproducible con instrucciones paso a paso y las herramientas empleadas Cuando el re-ensamblado sea fiable, planeo avanzar hacia la localización de textos y ajustes ligeros, por lo que valoraré un código claro, comentarios donde se descubran offsets críticos y scripts que automaticen el proceso. Aprecio experiencia previa con Gamebryo, IDA Pro, Ghidra o herramientas similares, pero lo importante es obtener un proyecto mantenible y una compilación idéntica al ejecutable original.

Alcance • Atender consultas de clientes de forma cordial y eficiente. • Operar simultáneamente en Chat en la página web, WhatsApp y Redes sociales, manteniendo el tono de la marca en cada canal. • Resolver de inmediato las preguntas más comunes sobre información de productos o servicios y gestionar cambios, devoluciones o reclamos siguiendo nuestros lineamientos internos. • Escalar los problemas que requieran intervención técnica o autorización especial y registrar cada caso para seguimiento. Lo que busco • Dominio del español escrito, excelente ortografía y capacidad para transmitir confianza. • Experiencia previa en atención multicanal (herramientas de chat web, WhatsApp Business, bandeja de mensajería en Facebook / Instagram). • Tiempo de respuesta rápido y disponibilidad para cubrir un horario previamente acordado. Entregables 1. Respuesta diaria a todos los mensajes entrantes durante el horario pactado. 2. Informe breve al final de cada jornada con número de consultas atendidas, temas frecuentes y casos escalados. Si cuentas con estas habilidades y te apasiona ayudar a los clientes, ¡me encantará conocer tu propuesta!"

opportunities.title: Guía y tutoría MATLAB-EEGLAB
opportunities.description: Nunca he usado MATLAB, pero necesito ejecutar EEGLAB para analizar registros de EEG que ya tengo en formato EDF/BDF. Busco a alguien que primero investigue y documente cómo integrar correctamente MATLAB con EEGLAB en mi sistema y, después, me enseñe a utilizar el flujo de trabajo básico para: • Instalar y configurar MATLAB, las toolboxes necesarias y la versión más estable de EEGLAB. • Importar archivos EDF/BDF a EEGLAB sin pérdida de canales ni metadatos. • Aplicar pasos de limpieza esenciales (filtros, detección/rechazo de artefactos, ICA) sobre datos previamente adquiridos. • Ejecutar análisis estándar (marcar eventos, crear epochs, calcular ERPs o espectros de potencia) con scripts reproducibles. • Guardar y exportar resultados y gráficos para futuras publicaciones. Quiero un paquete que incluya: – Un documento paso a paso con capturas y fragmentos de código comentado. – Una breve guía de conceptos básicos de MATLAB orientados a EEGLAB (funciones, rutas, variables, scripts). – Al menos dos sesiones en línea en vivo donde revisemos la instalación y corramos un ejemplo real con mis datos. – Respuestas a preguntas posteriores por escrito mientras practico. Valoraré que la explicación sea clara para principiantes y que el código quede listo para escalar a análisis más complejos en el futuro.

opportunities.title: Instructor Meta Ads para Curso Online
opportunities.description: Buscamos instructor de Meta Ads para desarrollar y grabar un curso online (básico a avanzado) Estamos buscando una persona con experiencia en Meta Ads (Facebook e Instagram Ads) que pueda desarrollar y grabar un curso educativo para nuestra academia. El objetivo es ofrecer a nuestros alumnos una formación práctica y completa que les permita aprender a crear, configurar, administrar y optimizar campañas publicitarias para sus propios negocios. Nuestros alumnos incluyen emprendedores, propietarios de pequeños negocios, profesionales independientes, estudios de belleza, spas y negocios locales que desean aprender a promocionar sus servicios mediante publicidad digital. ¿Qué necesitamos? Una persona que pueda: - Desarrollar un programa de formación desde nivel básico hasta avanzado. - Explicar paso a paso cómo utilizar el Administrador de anuncios de Meta. - Enseñar a crear campañas desde cero para Facebook e Instagram. - Explicar los objetivos de campaña, públicos, segmentación y presupuestos. - Enseñar a configurar anuncios, imágenes, videos y textos publicitarios. - Explicar cómo utilizar WhatsApp como destino para captar clientes. - Enseñar a revisar resultados, métricas y optimizar campañas. - Explicar cómo organizar campañas y administrar diferentes cuentas publicitarias. - Incluir ejemplos prácticos enfocados en pequeños negocios y servicios locales. Requisitos del instructor: - Experiencia demostrable trabajando con Meta Ads. - Capacidad para enseñar de manera clara, organizada y sencilla. - Hablar español. - Contar con equipo adecuado para grabar clases (micrófono, computadora y buena calidad de audio y video). - Tener conocimientos para grabar tutoriales de pantalla y explicar los procedimientos paso a paso. - Poder entregar las clases grabadas y organizadas por módulos. Modalidad del proyecto: Buscamos desarrollar un curso autograbado, dividido en módulos y lecciones, para que los alumnos puedan acceder al contenido y avanzar a su propio ritmo. Presupuesto: Actualmente no tenemos un presupuesto fijo establecido. Nos gustaría conocer las propuestas económicas de los interesados. Si estás interesado, puedes dejarnos en los comentarios tu presupuesto aproximado, una breve descripción de tu experiencia y algún ejemplo de cursos o trabajos que hayas realizado. Posteriormente, nos pondremos en contacto para explicar mejor el proyecto, definir el contenido, la cantidad de módulos, los entregables y acordar una estructura de pago. Le dejamos una pequeña referencia en imagen ¡Esperamos conocer tu propuesta!

El objetivo es ofrecer a nuestros alumnos una formación práctica y completa que les permita aprender a crear, configurar, administrar y optimizar campañas publicitarias para sus propios negocios. Nuestros alumnos incluyen emprendedores, propietarios de pequeños negocios, profesionales independientes, estudios de belleza, spas y negocios locales que desean aprender a promocionar sus servicios mediante publicidad digital. ¿Qué necesitamos? Una persona que pueda: - Desarrollar un programa de formación desde nivel básico hasta avanzado. - Explicar paso a paso cómo utilizar el Administrador de anuncios de Meta. - Enseñar a crear campañas desde cero para Facebook e Instagram. - Explicar los objetivos de campaña, públicos, segmentación y presupuestos. - Enseñar a configurar anuncios, imágenes, videos y textos publicitarios. - Explicar cómo utilizar WhatsApp como destino para captar clientes. - Enseñar a revisar resultados, métricas y optimizar campañas. - Explicar cómo organizar campañas y administrar diferentes cuentas publicitarias. - Incluir ejemplos prácticos enfocados en pequeños negocios y servicios locales. Requisitos del instructor: - Experiencia demostrable trabajando con Meta Ads. - Capacidad para enseñar de manera clara, organizada y sencilla. - Hablar español. - Contar con equipo adecuado para grabar clases (micrófono, computadora y buena calidad de audio y video). - Tener conocimientos para grabar tutoriales de pantalla y explicar los procedimientos paso a paso. - Poder entregar las clases grabadas y organizadas por módulos. Modalidad del proyecto: Buscamos desarrollar un curso autograbado, dividido en módulos y lecciones, para que los alumnos puedan acceder al contenido y avanzar a su propio ritmo. Presupuesto: Actualmente no tenemos un presupuesto fijo establecido. Nos gustaría conocer las propuestas económicas de los interesados. Si estás interesado, puedes dejarnos en los comentarios tu presupuesto aproximado, una breve descripción de tu experiencia y algún ejemplo de cursos o trabajos que hayas realizado. Posteriormente, nos pondremos en contacto para explicar mejor el proyecto, definir el contenido, la cantidad de módulos, los entregables y acordar una estructura de pago. Le dejamos una pequeña referencia en imagen ¡Esperamos conocer tu propuesta!"
